objective: Give each approved engineering task one manifest-bound feature branch and isolated worktree with deterministic resume, narrow draft-PR publication, and owner-verified cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: A strict canonical manifest hash binds the exact base SHA, feature branch, owner record, worktree path, and worker prompt.
Provisioning is idempotent for an exact same-manifest lane and refuses base drift, unknown branches, unknown directories, ownership mismatch, or a second active worker.
The supervisor receives narrow provision, status, and cleanup tools without a general shell; the worker receives status and publish; the reviewer receives status only.
Publication refuses dirty, empty, divergent, excluded, or outside-lane changes and can only push the exact non-force feature ref and create or confirm an open draft pull request.
Cleanup revalidates the clean local head, remote head, and exact draft PR, removes only the owned worktree without force, and retains both branches.
The repository-scoped GitHub helper no longer prints raw tokens and rejects merge, ready-for-review, API mutation, and non-draft PR commands.
The installed Mac OpenClaw build loads the reviewed lane plugin and a secret-free provision/resume/refusal/publish/cleanup rehearsal passes.
stopConditions: A branch, worktree, owner record, manifest hash, remote URL, or base SHA does not match exactly.
A changed path is outside ownedPaths or inside excludedPaths.
A push would target main, use force, delete a ref, or create anything other than an open draft pull request.
Live validation would expose a GitHub or 1Password token, touch production, or mutate the unrelated default OpenClaw runtime.
